title: Christian Gonzalez on possible contract extension: I don't want to be anywhere else

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Christian Gonzalez on possible contract extension: I don't want to be anywhere else
sources.description: Cornerback Christian Gonzalez's play was a bright spot for the Patriots in an otherwise dark Super Bowl LX and the team has a chance to ensure Gonzalez remains in the lineup for years to come over the offseason.
